ios.desc: Numms is a notepad for numbers, it has a built-in calculator, unlimited offline storage, has dark mode and it is fully responsive

show_hn.title: Show HN: Numms, a Responsive Calculator with History for iPad and iOS

quotes.text:
Hi,

I'm an Indie Designer/Developer. I learned to code a couple of years ago and worked in a co-founded startup, but this is my first solo project.

Numms is a fully responsive calculator that adapts to the screen of the iPad when using the Stage Manager or a split view. It also works on the iPhone. Some other functionalities include:

+ History (Persistent local storage)

+ Notes for your calculations

+ Sheets (like pages in an Excel file)

+ Memories (Global for all sheets or local per sheet)

+ Dark/Light mode

It was developed in Flutter but is only supported on Apple devices due to the new Google Play policy about the 20 testers. Please write me an email at: hellodiegosebastian@gmail.com if you'd like to help me test it on Android.

Thank you in advance for all your comments and feedback.
